verdict.rationale: Account-free or file-number entry is a fair question for a state business-filing service, so the axis applies. Nothing in the pack documents a keyless or file-number path into the core filing flow. The Ohio Business Gateway pages describe sign-in through an OHID credential account, and the Secretary of State's own sites (ohiosos.gov and the Business Central portal) returned 403 at robots.txt, so none of their published pages could be read.
